purpose: A simulator-independent software interface between wireless link generators and the frozen PhyGuard diagnosis pipeline.

kpis.name: rsrp_db
kpis.definition: Normalized desired reference-signal receive power expressed in dB relative to the generator reference.

kpis.name: rssi_db
kpis.definition: Normalized total received power including desired signal, interference, and thermal noise.

kpis.name: sinr_db
kpis.definition: Desired receive power divided by interference-plus-noise power.

kpis.name: evm_rms
kpis.definition: Root-mean-square error-vector magnitude after equalization, normalized by transmitted-symbol power.

kpis.name: ber_pre_ldpc
kpis.definition: Coded-bit error rate before LDPC decoding.

kpis.name: bler_post_ldpc
kpis.definition: Transport/code-block error ratio after 5G LDPC decoding. This replaces the original 48-bit packet surrogate in the independent validation.

kpis.name: cqi_index
kpis.definition: Quantized channel-quality index derived only from estimated link quality.

kpis.name: mcs_index
kpis.definition: State of the delayed link-adaptation controller.

kpis.name: goodput_ratio
kpis.definition: Successfully delivered information bits divided by the nominal information-bit opportunity.

kpis.name: channel_correlation
kpis.definition: Normalized complex correlation between the current estimated channel state and the receiver-visible channel estimate delayed by a fixed software processing age.

receiver_state_semantics.warmup_policy: Current-frame CSI is used only for the first csi_age_frames because no earlier estimate exists.
receiver_state_semantics.purpose: Measure CSI freshness under a fixed receiver processing delay.

revision_reason: Versioned CSI-freshness semantics for mobility-induced receiver-state aging. KPI names and tensor shape remain unchanged.
